Package index

Running the application

The Shiny interface. run_app() is the usual entry point; the other two are exposed so a Shiny Server or shinyapps.io deployment can build the application directly.

run_app()
Launch the inter-plot competition application
app_ui()
User interface for the inter-plot competition application
app_server()
Server logic for the inter-plot competition application

Preparing a trial

The scripted pipeline, in the order it is used: validate and reshape the trial, pad the field to a complete rectangle for a spatial residual, then attach the neighbouring genotypes.

prepare_trial_data()
Validate and reshape an uploaded trial into the internal analysis layout.
complete_field_grid()
Pad every environment to its full rectangular grid
add_neighbours()
Attach neighbour-genotype factors to the trial data.

Fitting the model

Both fitting functions require a licensed ASReml-R installation, which is commercial software and is not supplied by this package.

fit_single_model()
Fit the single-trial competition model.
fit_met_model()
Fit the multi-environment competition model

Genetic relationships

Replace the default assumption of independent genotypes with a pedigree, a kinship matrix or a marker-derived genomic relationship matrix.

build_relationship()
Build a relationship object from whichever source the user supplied.

Diagnostics

Whether the field layout can actually support a competition model. Both are worth running before a fit, not after.

competition_diagnostics()
Diagnostics on how well the competition term is supported by the layout.
competition_warnings()
Warnings about a layout that cannot support a competition model

Figures

Every figure is a ggplot2 object, so it can be themed, combined or saved like any other. save_figure() scales the text to the export size.

plot_field_map()
Field-plan heatmap of an observed or fitted quantity.
plot_direct_vs_competition()
Direct effect against competitive effect.
plot_ranking()
Ranked pure-stand (or direct) effects with exact confidence intervals.
plot_rank_change()
How much does accounting for competition change the selection decision?
plot_variance_components()
Variance components as a share of the total.
plot_residual_diagnostics()
Residual diagnostics: fitted values, normal quantiles and distribution.
plot_correlation_heatmap()
Genetic-correlation heatmap between environments.
plot_environment_variances()
Direct, competitive and pure-stand genetic variance in each environment.
plot_stability()
Stability of pure-stand performance across environments.
plot_met_scatter()
Direct against competitive effects, one panel per environment.
save_figure()
Save a ggplot to file at a chosen size and resolution.

Worked example data

Simulated from known parameters and from a fixed seed, so a fitted model can be checked against the values that generated the data.

sample_single_trial()
Worked example: a single trial with inter-plot competition
sample_met_trial()
Worked example: a multi-environment trial series
sample_pedigree()
Worked example: a pedigree for the example trials
